thread:
olivia: Heads-up — deploy-bot just flagged a staging canary p95 spike after the 2.8.0 rollout. Need a quick call: rollback or let it run another 10m? @miguel @sam

deploy-bot: [ALERT] p95 latency +42% vs baseline for /generate (staging). Auto-rollback threshold = 40%. Suggested action: review; auto action will fire in 2m unless deferred. https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/1229 :rotating_light:

miguel: I can take this. Quick glance — KV cache miss rate jumped around the same time as a higher decode retry rate. Suspect a batching/kvcache interaction.

sam: Can we pin staging back to 2.7.1 while we triage? buys time and avoids noisy auto-rollback. Command: `redwoodctl release pin --env staging --version 2.7.1`

anya: prefer to wait 5-10m to confirm if it's transient — any error spike data? could be a fluke from a single job.

olivia: errors are up ~1.8x on model decode timeout in staging, not huge but with latency spike it's risky. leaning rollback unless someone objects.

pm-jen: if we rollback, I'll draft a short internal + customer-facing note. If we pin, we should freeze release notes and mark the change window.

miguel: FYI deploy config: we have `defer_if_human_present: 10m` so auto-rollback will wait for a human decision for up to 10m. Tie-break authority is eng-releases rotation (human in channel). Who is current oncall?

oncall-bot: eng-oncall: miguel is current until 2026-04-01T08:00Z.

olivia: OK — I'll authorize a manual rollback to be safe. @miguel please execute. If you're busy, @sam please take it.

miguel: executing now. Running: `redwoodctl release rollback --env staging --to-version 2.7.1 --reason "p95 spike after 2.8.0 rollout"`

deploy-bot: rollback job started by miguel. Roll ID: roll-1254. ETA ~90s. Will post status updates.

sam: watching dashboards — p95 already trending down, kv-miss rate decreasing toward baseline.

pm-jen: drafting internal comms: "Staging deploy rolled back to 2.7.1 due to increased latency during canary; no production customers impacted." Posting to #product and drafting status page snippet.

miguel: rollback completed. Canary traffic pinned to 2.7.1 for staging. Confirming smoke checks... all green.

olivia: great — manual rollback executed, leaving release notes frozen until we triage the root cause. I'll open a short follow-up ops doc and add the triage owners. :white_check_mark:

pm-jen: added a note to the release notes doc: "HOLD - investigation into 2.8.0 staging latency spike."

olivia: follow-up actions: 1) miguel/sam run kvcache replay test, 2) eng-runtime to check batching kernel selector, 3) decide on remediated patch or reattempt after fix. We'll reconvene in #eng-releases in 30m.

deploy-bot: [INFO] Auto-rollback suppressed due to manual-decision. Roll ID roll-1254.

olivia: thanks all, closing this thread for now. Update here with triage notes. :pray:
